Five-order numerical normal-dot checks corroborate. No infinite statement relies on computation.

value.rationale: A natural minimax angle invariant of a newly identified class of extremal spherical four-polytopes is solved sharply for all polygon orders and relative radii, together with a complete ridge-angle spectrum and unique equal-angle geometry. This distinguishes global volume optimization from dihedral regularization, and identifies a rigid transition at equal polygon orders; it is not a mere new numerical value.
